caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright bottle made of what appears to be ceramic or stoneware. The bottle has a narrow, slightly flared neck that leads to a rounded shoulder and then tapers to a wider, cylindrical body before narrowing slightly at the base. The color of the bottle is a warm, earthy brown with subtle variations and darker speckles throughout its surface, giving it a textured appearance. The lighting highlights some reflective patches and shading that provide depth, while the bottle sits on a plain, light beige background. At the bottom of the image, there is text in uppercase serif letters that reads, "BOTTLE · EARLY 19th CENTURY." There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the drawing.
